female.sp: MSK-008 Dijeh, original turquoise Karaba configuration from Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam, not the Narrative or Char variant. The attached Bandai model photographs are mechanical design references only; the front three-quarter and rear views show the same equipment identity. Preserve turquoise-green limbs, dark navy torso and split skirt, yellow chest vents, red central cockpit accent, substantial asymmetric shoulder armor: a broad curved dark shield-like guard on her RIGHT shoulder and a blocky turquoise left shoulder. Preserve TWO tall leaf-shaped heat-radiator fins rising from the backpack, with dark structural borders, turquoise inner surfaces and pointed tips; these are rigid radiator panels, never feathers or fabric. Preserve bell-shaped lower-leg armor and rear calf vents. Keep one beam rifle and one clay bazooka visibly stowed along the backpack outside the radiator panels and one yellow unlit beam-naginata handle mounted across the rear waist, without duplicate weapons. A small single pink mono-eye sensor jewel and narrow central antenna ornament above her brow preserve the head motif, while her face has two natural human eyes and remains fully unobstructed. Keep shoulder armor intact; the open fitted armor design leaves collarbones, waist sides and upper-thigh gaps visible between plates. Keep both complete radiator fins, stowed weapons, antenna and feet inside the frame with generous margins. No labels, logos, model numbers, watermark or pilot resemblance.
